jobs.title: People Advisor
jobs.description_text:
About Us
Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 $200M+ in ARR
, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.
We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
Joining Legora means three things.
We 
lean in: 
ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
We 
fight for excellence:
 high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
We
 grow together:
 as a team and with our customers.
Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
About the role
You're the local face of People at Legora: bringing local expertise, judgement and a strong understanding of employment practices to support employees and managers through a range of people matters. You will provide local advisory support, run local casework from start to finish, fill process and policy gaps, and make sure the employee experience in your market is accurate, timely and well handled. This is a hands-on, operational role and a strong launchpad for your next step. You'll be close enough to the business to understand how each function really works, trusted to make real judgment calls on the ground, and sharp enough to know when something needs a specialist instead. Sitting within People Operations, you will act as an escalation for our People Operations Specialists, providing guidance and resolving matters that require local interpretation, judgement or a more tailored approach
You'll partner closely with Employee Relations & Compliance, who own our jurisdictional frameworks, create consistent standards, and provide specialist expertise for complex, contested or legally sensitive matters. You'll also work alongside our People Business Partners, sharing local insights and supporting the effective delivery of people initiatives and organisational changes within your local market.
What you'll own
Provide practical advice to employees, managers and People Operations colleagues on local employment practices, policies and people matters that require interpretation or judgement.
Running local cases from start to finish within the scope of your certification, including absence management, ongoing performance concerns and restructuring conversations, with each one properly scoped, documented and closed
Handling intake for leave, accommodation and absence requests, resolving what's routine and recognizing what needs to go further
Building out local process and policy, and ensuring people programs effectively land in your market.
Identify opportunities to improve local processes, employee experiences and ways of working, collaborating with other People teams to implement improvements.
Applying your market's jurisdiction playbook accurately and consistently, and flagging where it doesn't fit local reality
Recognizing the moment a matter becomes formal, contested or legally sensitive, and handing it off the same day with everything the next person needs to pick it up seamlessly
Keeping your certification and calibration current so your casework meets the same standard as every other market
Work closely with People Business Partners and Employee Relations & Compliance, sharing local trends,

jobs.title: Senior Counsel (London, United Kingdom)
jobs.description_text:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We're looking for a senior lawyer with strong experience advising on commercial and technology matters to join our legal team. You'll be working in an exciting and constantly evolving environment while establishing relationships cross-functionally with our sales, strategic partnerships, and other teams to close contracts with our customers and partners. 

This is a full time role that can be held from our London hub or remotely in the United Kingdom.

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Lead on complex, strategic deals, drafting and negotiating customer-facing agreements: software services agreements, data processing agreements, regulatory annexes, security documents and privacy policies
  • Draft and negotiate distribution, reseller, professional services and referral agreements
  • Act as a strategic adviser to key business partners on complex legal issues, working closely with Sales, Deal Desk, Revenue Recognition and other stakeholders
  • Track emerging legal and regulatory developments, including the EU AI Act, and develop policy and risk positions where needed
  • Work with Revenue Recognition, Security, Sales Operations and other teams so our agreements are consistent with Figma's policies and processes
  • Mentor colleagues, including junior lawyers working with you on deals, and help improve our legal resources and know-how

We’d love to hear from you if you:

  • Are a UK-qualified solicitor, at least 6 years PQE with relevant experience reviewing, drafting and negotiating commercial and technology agreements (for example enterprise sales agreements, data processing agreements and SaaS agreements) and partnership agreements (for example service partner, reseller and referral agreements)
  • Build relationships and credibility easily, and enjoy partnering with others
  • Work hard and stay comfortable in a fast-paced, fast-changing environment, whether the project is large or small
  • Understand AI, privacy and other regulatory issues in commercial tech transactions
  • Have experience using and advising on artificial intelligence

While it’s not required, it’s an added plus if you also have:

  • Additional language skills, especially French and German
  • A privacy qualification, such as CIPP/E
At Figma, one of our values is Grow as you go. We believe in hiring smart, curious people who are excited to learn and develop their skills. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the points outlined in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

At Figma we celebrate and support our differences. We know employing a team rich in diverse thoughts, experiences, and opinions allows our employees, our product and our community to flourish. Figma is an equal opportunity workplace - we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender iden

jobs.title: Account Executive, Growth - France
jobs.description_text:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust.
 
We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 
Vanta is growing quickly, and we consistently outpace our growth targets while maintaining very strong NPS. Our Sales team is leading the charge in growing market share as the industry leader in compliance and security. 
Winning in international markets is critical to Vanta’s next chapter, and we’re building our EMEA presence from the ground up. We’re looking for customer-focused French-speaking Account Executives and true market builders who are excited to open up the largely untapped French market. You’ll be among the first to shape how Vanta shows up in the region: partnering with Marketing and Partnerships to build brand presence, initiating events that generate pipeline, and owning your full sales cycle from first outreach to closed-won. As we move up-market, you’ll also help define our sales motion and establish Vanta as the best-in-class choice in an increasingly competitive landscape.
This role is based in our London office with an office-centric hybrid schedule, with standard in-office days on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday. You’ll work side by side with our EMEA landing team, where the energy, collaboration, and early-stage impact are hard to replicate remotely.
What you’ll do as a Account Executive, Growth at Vanta:
Own your pipeline from the ground up. Identify, research, and prioritize high-potential accounts and verticals, and build a consistent outbound motion to create new opportunities.
Turn inbound demand into closed-won business. Convert interest into long-term Vanta customers who see lasting value.
Run a world-class sales process. Qualify deeply, forecast accurately, and progress deals using MEDDPICC or a similar methodology to drive predictable outcomes.
Show the business value of Vanta. Deliver compelling demos and tailor recommendations to each customer’s goals.
Communicate with executive presence. Engage confidently with founders, CEOs, and technical leaders, translating complex security and compliance concepts into clear business value.
Build Vanta’s presence in France. Partner with Marketing and Partnerships to build brand awareness, and explore partnership opportunities that open up new and existing markets.
Initiate and own event success. Identify the right events in your market, rally internal partners, and drive them from planning through pipeline.
Work cross-functionally. Partner with SDRs, Marketing, Partnerships, Legal, and Solutions Engineers to source, run, and win deals.
Be a voice for the customer. Share prospect and market insights with Product to inform our roadmap.
Keep sharpening your craft. Act on feedback, seek coaching, and contribute to team playbooks, messaging, and outbound best practices.
How to be successful in this role:
5+ years of full-cycle closing experience in a quota-carrying role, consistently exceeding monthly and quarterly targets.
B2B SaaS experience, preferably selling into SMB and Mid-Market accounts.
Experience self-sourcing pipeline through outbound prospecting.
Fluency in English and French.
Experience partnering cross-functionally with partnerships and marketing to build brand presence in a new market.
A track record of initiating events and owning their success, from planning through pipeline. You’ll be expected to do the same in your territory.
The technical competency to understand Vanta’s product and build strong relationships with highly technical prospects.
Deep curiosity about customers and their needs, with empathy and a track record of building long-term relationships and retention.
Entrepreneurial spirit, initiative, and autonomy to make a major contribution to our EMEA landing team and have a big impact earl

jobs.title: Data Instructor  (Internal)
jobs.description_text:
Multiverse is the upskilling platform for AI and Tech adoption.
We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.
Our upskilling apprenticeships are designed for people of any age and career stage to build critical AI, data, and tech skills. Our learners have driven $2bn+ ROI for their employers, using the skills they’ve learned to improve productivity and measurable performance.
In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.
But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.
Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.
The Opportunity
As an instructor, you will be responsible for the delivery of our technical content and supporting our apprentices in upskilling in these technical areas through workshops and drop in sessions. You will help apprentices develop the appropriate Knowledge, Skills & Behaviours throughout their programme.
The Multiverse delivery team is a diverse mix of industry experts, educators, and academics, working together to build the future of work. You will be part of this team, reporting to a Delivery Lead who will guide your development.
To ensure a strong start, you will complete a 3-week onboarding programme, covering:
Modern teaching methodologies - for a hands-on, engaging learning experience
Technical upskilling - to align with the relevant apprenticeship standard
Practical coaching opportunities - a rigorous, robust feedback process to get you ready to launch your programme
At the end of onboarding, you will be ready to support Multiverse apprentices, helping them develop technical expertise and industry-relevant skills relating to AI and Data domains and drive impact within their businesses. We believe this is an opportunity like no other!
Specifically, you will:
Confidently facilitate delivery sessions of our technical Learning content, ensuring the session delivers against learning objectives within the allotted time.
Adhere to the Coach Quality framework to ensure a consistent level of quality for every session and a consistent experience for every apprentice.
Create a vibrant, inclusive and motivating environment that drives apprentice learning, engagement and overall satisfaction.
Moderate assignments in line with mark schemes to ensure quality and consistency while providing feedback and feed forward for apprentices to continually develop their technical and durable skills.
Maintain an owners mentality, whether assigned a learner or in support of other coaches, being proactive in taking action, sharing feedback, or providing support to ensure the progress and success of learners.
Regularly liaise with coaches to align on apprentice interventions to ensure successful completion of programme.
Coordinate with cohort coaches and operations members to align on apprentice development and progress.
Utilise resources & learning opportunities provided by Multiverse, stay up-to-date on knowledge, learning and product updates, to ensure you are equipped to support your apprentices.
Build & maintain credibility with your apprentices by utilising a mixture of professional experience, program/domain/industry knowledge and client context in your interactions.
Create a compelling narrative about Multiverse, our mission, and the pillars of our offering, and help apprentices connect to it through the duration of their apprenticeship, and beyond.

You possess strong written and on-camera communication and presentation skills.
